svg.title: FNABK campus provisional pixel-to-studs preview
svg.desc: Uncalibrated AI-generated reference geometry. Canonical pixel vertices are preserved; this preview is mirrored left-to-right. Local +X points to image left and local +Z is image up after Y inversion. No north or 1:1 accuracy claim.

g.text: PIXEL PREVIEW · NOT SURVEYED · NO NORTH ALIGNMENT
